task_description: Módulo 3: Autenticación (Login + Registro) for the multiplatform fitness app. Decide and implement secure token storage as a platform-adaptive abstraction (shared TokenStorage interface + web localStorage impl working/tested now + documented expo-secure-store native impl behind runtime platform selection + useAuthStorage hook). Build Login and Registro forms with react-hook-form + @hookform/resolvers/zod + zod, Spanish field errors, cross-field password match on Registro, and submit handlers READY for a future API/Supabase connection via an injectable onSubmit that logs ONLY a redacted shape (never the raw password) so ESLint no-console stays green. UI uses the Enchanted/Cozy Tailwind design tokens and existing primitives in apps/macros-web (the DOM web module where Tailwind actually renders), not the React Native root app. TypeScript strict, immutability, small files. TDD, 80%+ coverage, unit + integration + E2E.

verification.summary: Final verification run with the Module-1 energy domain temporarily materialized from main (NOT committed) so the full macros-web module resolves the @energy alias as it will once Module 3 is based on a branch containing Modules 1+2. Results from apps/macros-web: typecheck clean (tsc --noEmit strict), eslint clean (no-console enforced, ZERO disables), vite build produced dist/ (84 modules). Vitest 95/95 tests across 13 files pass; overall coverage 98.47% stmts / 87.85% branch / 95.45% funcs; auth files 96.56% stmts / 81.25% branch / 100% funcs; storage 100% stmts / 96.29% branch; schemas 100%. Playwright E2E 3/3 pass in real chromium (new e2e/auth.spec.ts logs in, asserts success status, switches to Registro, confirms the Confirmar contraseña field). Test quality verified: storage unit tests do real save/get/delete round-trips on the web impl + assert platform selection flips on navigator.product; form integration tests drive RHF via user-event, assert Spanish validation errors block submit, assert the Registro cross-field password-match error on confirmPassword, assert a valid submit invokes the injected handler with validated data, assert the logger receives ONLY the redacted shape (raw password proven absent via JSON.stringify of mock call args), and assert the mocked storage receives a session token. The temporarily materialized energy domain was removed after verification; only the 3 auth feature commits + task docs remain. No Dockerfile (docker build not applicable). Root Expo app untouched.
verification.merge_order_note: The three auth commits (fd97ab6, 675c728, de9236d) currently sit on feat/modulo-2-macros-wizard. Base Module 3 on a branch (feat/modulo-3-auth) cut from a point that contains BOTH the Module-1 energy domain (on main) and the Module-2 macros-web module, so the @energy alias resolves and the full build/typecheck/E2E are green without materializing anything.

architecture_notes: The user prompt is internally contradictory (React Native Expo + literal Tailwind CSS classes + expo-secure-store native API + localStorage web fallback). Resolution (consistent with the APPROVED Module 2): build the Auth UI in apps/macros-web (Vite+React+Tailwind DOM module) where the exact Tailwind directives (focus:border-[#8a9a5b], hover:-translate-y-0.5, backdrop-blur) literally render; honor the expo-secure-store-vs-localStorage decision via a platform-adaptive TokenStorage abstraction with BOTH implementations behind the same interface. Web impl ships working+tested now; native expo-secure-store impl is delivered as the native branch (lazy-imported so it never breaks the web build) with its exact install command, ready to plug into the Expo app via the same interface. Branch base: feat/modulo-3-auth off feat/modulo-2-macros-wizard so the macros-web module + tooling exist. The auth code is self-contained and does NOT use the @energy alias; the pre-existing wizard/domain suites depend on the Module-1 energy domain, which lives on main, so the full suite is green only on a branch containing both Module 1 and Module 2.
